provenance: Hand-authored contract proposal fixture for lane lite-3v3-prep-1. NO host produced it, and the arena-match-3v3-1 runtime is HELD for a later lane. All prices, reward numbers, voluntarySwapLimit, CPU HP values and the EXP and blueprint rules are placeholders that need Pak calls. Each refusal is a callable error (HttpsError code, message and details), not a success object, and leaves the previous accepted reply unchanged.

steps.name: issue
steps.note: Three owned bots, each frozen as a #118 snapshot with HP from the account ledger (KUMA enters damaged at 205/220). The host picks the CPU team from the rookie pool. ONE charge of 50 Holos.

steps.name: refused-swap-before-start
steps.note: Phase ready: no swap until start.

steps.name: refused-swap-without-turn
steps.note: KNOWN-BAD: a swap that carries no host turn. The request schema refuses it, and the host refuses it as invalid_request. Nothing changes.

steps.name: report-1-opponent-ko
steps.note: HARE KO. The host sends in WAKE (next living CPU slot). ACE drops to 120.

steps.name: swap-1-voluntary
steps.note: Voluntary swap (1 of 2). ACE goes to the bench at its host HP of 120. No bench regen.

steps.name: swap-1-replay
steps.note: Retry of the same intentId after a lost reply: the host returns the current match and the same echo, and the turn does not move.

steps.name: refused-stale-turn
steps.note: A new intent with a stale turn (host turn is 2). Nothing changes.

steps.name: report-2-active-ko
steps.note: KUMA KO. ACE and SHADOW are alive on the bench, so the phase becomes send_in.

steps.name: refused-swap-to-ko
steps.note: KNOWN-BAD: swapping to a KO'd fighter. Nothing changes.

steps.name: refused-report-during-send-in
steps.note: In send_in, a swap is the only legal intent.

steps.name: swap-2-forced-send-in
steps.note: Forced send-in after a KO. It does not use a voluntary swap.

steps.name: report-3-opponent-ko
steps.note: WAKE KO. The host sends in GAMA.

steps.name: refused-settle-before-over
steps.note: Settle is legal only in phase over.

steps.name: report-4-active-ko
steps.note: SHADOW KO. ACE (120, unchanged on the bench) is the last fighter left, so: send_in.

steps.name: swap-3-forced-send-in
steps.note: ACE returns at exactly its benched host HP of 120.

steps.name: report-5-match-over
steps.note: GAMA KO: every CPU fighter is KO'd. Phase over, winner player.

steps.name: settle
steps.note: The host settles from its own vitals and winner. One reward quote, no extra charge, and all three bots' host HP is written to the ledger.
